title: Promotional Materials Recruiting Rubric
description: Five criteria, ten points, three sample flyers -- and the lowest row matters more than the total.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Reaching Underserved Communities and Removing Barriers

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a description of a sample club flyer or web page, the learner scores it against five recruiting-equity criteria and identifies the single lowest-scoring criterion to fix first.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Load a sample flyer, review or override each score, then reveal the weakest criterion
pedagogical.assessment: Score the club's own flyer and name the one thing to fix.
